title: 第847章 乌龟提醒第846章 裂缝穿行
slug: 我在修仙界竟然苟成大佬
content_zh:
小青沉稳地给出了总结性发言：主人今非昔比，渡劫巅峰实力加神识加持，寻常空间乱流已然无法构成威胁。龟前辈摸鱼实属正常，因为确实不需要它出手。
几人闲聊的工夫宁知初已经往前又走了数十步。前方虚空突然塌陷了一块——那种塌陷不是空间的弯曲或震荡，而是整片区域像是被什么东西从内部一口吞掉了，留下一片漆黑幽深的空洞悬浮在混沌之中。黑洞的吸力极强疯狂拉扯着周围所有的气流和灵力碎片，空气中那些微小的空间裂隙被吸得朝着黑洞方向扭曲变形。
宁知初脚下灵力稳稳扎根虚空身形纹丝不动。她感知了一下黑洞的边缘范围然后侧身从左侧绕了过去，绕行的时候刻意保持着跟黑洞边缘的安全距离，既不太近也不太远。整个过程从容不迫跟绕过路上一个水坑一样随意。
桃夭夭在簪子里安静地看了一会儿然后忍不住好奇地问了一句：龟前辈，这条裂缝这么凶险这么多乱流黑洞，为什么永远不会消失呀？它不会自己慢慢平息掉吗？
小乌龟难得愿意多解释两句。它把脑袋从壳里往外伸了一点点，语速依旧是那种不紧不慢的节奏，但这次的句子稍微长了一些：无边海为两界夹缝，天道规则错乱空间本就不稳。两界之力常年对冲自然永续乱流永不平息。如同河床上的礁石被激流日夜冲刷却因为激流从未断过所以礁石一直在。乱流本身就是因为两界之力对冲产生的，只要两界还在那里，乱流就不会消失。
桃夭夭似懂非懂地了一声然后用自己的理解总结了一句：原来是两界打架产生的后遗症！两个大陆的天地规则互不相让在这里撞来撞去所以永远消停不了！怪不得这么凶！
宁知初被她这总结逗得笑出了声：你这总结倒是简单直白。两界打架的后遗症，这个说法我还真没听过，但细想一下还真是这么回事。
桃夭夭得意地晃了晃簪身：我活了这么多年别的本事没有，把复杂的事情往简单了说还是会的。那些天道规则阵纹道韵什么的说着拗口想着费劲，换成掰手腕闹别扭就好懂多了。
小乌龟趴着没动但尾巴尖微微翘了一下——宁知初怀疑它是在憋笑。
前方的混沌虚空中又是一阵剧烈的空间波动。数道乱流同时从不同方向窜出来交织成一张密不透风的杀网朝着宁知初所在的位置合拢过来。这次她不能只靠侧身闪避了——四面八方的攻击同时压过来几乎封死了所有退路。
她脚下猛地一踏整个人如同被弹射出去的箭矢般向上拔高了丈许，在空中翻转了半圈之后精准地落在一片恰好稳定下来的虚空区域上。那几张乱流编织成的网在她脚下交错碰撞激起一圈猛烈的空间震荡余波，但她已经站在了安全的高度上俯看着那些乱流互相绞杀湮灭。
整个过程快得连桃夭夭都没来得及惊呼一声就已经结束了。
小乌龟这次终于在她落定之前开口了。它说的三个字比上次多了那么一点提前量：向上，翻。虽然宁知初已经在做这个动作了但它的话跟她的动作几乎是同步的，比之前那些危险过去了才开口的情况已经进步了不少。
宁知初落定之后忍不住夸了它一句：前辈进步了，这次终于在我躲完之前开口了。
小乌龟沉默了片刻然后慢悠悠地回了一句：你说的对，慢了点。下次早点。
宁知初有点意外地挑了挑眉——这只佛系大佬居然还会自我反省？真是稀罕事。
发髻里的桃夭夭笑得簪身直颤：龟前辈居然反思了！万年难遇！我得记下来！
空间裂缝深处翻涌的混沌依旧在持续着。前方还有一段不短的路要穿行，但宁知初心里很清楚——这次她走起来比上次轻松太多了。同样的路不同的修为不同的心境，连那些乱流的威胁感在她感知中都比上次弱了不止一个层次。
一路往前穿行，乱流从未间断过。一波接着一波层层叠叠地涌过来，仿佛这片混沌虚空里所有的空间之力都在跟闯入者较劲，不给任何喘息的机会。有横向横扫的狂暴乱流像一堵移动的墙一样压过来，有纵向撕裂的细碎空间刃从头顶直直劈落如同无形的长刀，有凭空炸开的空间爆破在虚空中爆出一圈圈震荡涟漪把四周的混沌气流搅得天翻地覆，还有暗藏虚空的隐匿暗流表面看着平静实际底下藏着致命的杀机。所有危险全部毫无规律随机出现，没有任何前兆没有任何轨迹可以预判，全靠反应和感知硬扛。
换做普通渡劫修士走进来，哪怕有护体屏障加持也得步步惊心小心翼翼，稍有不慎就会被一道乱流擦中轻则护体屏障碎裂重则身受重伤。不少渡劫大能一辈子都不敢涉足这种地方，就是因为这里的凶险太过随机、太过不可控，谁也没把握自己一定能活着走出去。

但如今的宁知初状态完全不同了。她全程走得稳稳当当从容不迫，每一步都踏在恰到好处的位置上，每一次侧身都精准地避开了来袭的乱流。那些能让普通渡劫修士狼狈不堪的危险在她面前似乎都慢了半拍，她的动作总是比乱流快那么一些。
即使偶尔遇到那种速度极快、根本来不及自己反应的突发危险，肩头的小乌龟也会提前开口提醒。它的语速依旧慢悠悠的但时机把握比上次精准了不少——至少是在宁知初需要行动的时候开口，而不是等她躲完了再补一句。宁知初每次听到指示就立刻照做从不犹豫，左移右移上跃下蹲，整套动作行云流水配合默契。
发髻里全程围观的桃夭夭看得心服口服，簪子里的碎碎念就没停过。
知初你也太稳了吧！这么多乱七八糟的危险你一步都没踩空！我刚才看左边那道乱流从你背后擦过去就差了那么一丁点距离，你连眼皮都没多眨一下！
宁知初侧身避开一道从脚底窜出的暗流，随口回了一句：习惯了。走的次数多了身体会记住节奏，空间乱流虽然随机但人的反应是可以练出来的。
content_en:
Xiao Qing gave a concluding speech calmly: The master is no longer what he used to be. With the peak strength of transcending tribulation and the blessing of divine consciousness, ordinary space turbulence no longer poses a threat. It's normal for Senior Turtle to fish for fish, because there is really no need for him to take action.
While the few people were chatting, Ning Zhichu had already taken dozens of steps forward. The void in front suddenly collapsed - that kind of collapse was not a bending or oscillation of space, but the entire area seemed to be swallowed up from the inside by something, leaving a dark and deep hole suspended in the chaos. The black hole's extremely strong suction force pulls all the surrounding air currents and spiritual energy fragments crazily, and the tiny space cracks in the air are sucked to twist and deform in the direction of the black hole.
Ning Zhichu's spiritual power under his feet was firmly rooted in the void, and his body remained motionless. She sensed the edge of the black hole and then turned sideways to the left. When going around, she deliberately kept a safe distance from the edge of the black hole, neither too close nor too far. The whole process was as leisurely as going around a puddle in the road.
Tao Yaoyao looked quietly in the hairpin for a while and then couldn't help but asked curiously: Senior Turtle, this crack is so dangerous and has so many turbulent black holes, why will it never disappear? Won't it calm down on its own?
It's rare for the little turtle to be willing to explain a few more words. It stretched its head out of the shell a little bit, and its speech rate was still the same unhurried rhythm, but this time the sentences were slightly longer: The boundless sea is a gap between two worlds, and the rules of heaven are chaotic and space is inherently unstable. The forces of the two realms are in conflict all year round, and the natural and everlasting turbulence will never subside. Just like the rocks on the river bed are washed away by the rapids day and night, but because the rapids never break, the rocks always remain. The turbulence itself is caused by the conflict between the two realms. As long as the two realms are still there, the turbulence will not disappear.
Tao Yaoyao seemed to understand something and then summed it up with her own understanding: It turned out to be the sequelae of the fight between the two worlds! The rules of heaven and earth on the two continents are incompatible with each other, and they are colliding here, so they can never stop! No wonder it’s so fierce!
Ning Zhichu was amused by her summary and laughed out loud: Your summary is simple and straightforward. I have never heard of this term about the sequelae of the fight between the two worlds, but if you think about it carefully, it is really the case.
Tao Yaoyao shook her hairpin proudly: I have lived for so many years and have no other abilities. I can still simplify complicated things. Those rules of heaven, formations, patterns, rhymes, etc. are difficult to pronounce and hard to think about. It would be much easier to understand if they were replaced by arm-wrestling and awkwardness.
The little turtle lay motionless but the tip of its tail was slightly raised - Ning Zhichu suspected that it was suppressing a smile.
There was another violent spatial fluctuation in the chaotic void ahead. Several turbulent currents sprang out from different directions at the same time, intertwining into an airtight killing net and closing in on Ning Zhichu's position. This time she couldn't just dodge sideways - attacks from all directions were coming at the same time, almost blocking all escape routes.
She suddenly stepped forward and her whole body shot upwards like an arrow. She flipped half a circle in the air and landed accurately on an area of ​​void that happened to be stable. The nets woven by the turbulent currents collided with each other under her feet, causing a violent space shock, but she was already standing at a safe height and looked down at the turbulent currents strangled and annihilated each other.
The whole process was so fast that it was over before Tao Yaoyao even had time to scream.
The little turtle finally spoke this time before she settled down. The three words it said were slightly more advanced than last time: up, turn. Although Ning Zhichu was already doing this action, its words were almost synchronized with her movements, which was a lot better than the previous situation where it spoke only after the danger had passed.
After Ning Zhichu settled down, he couldn't help but praise it: "Senior has made progress. This time he finally spoke before I finished hiding."
The little turtle was silent for a moment and then replied slowly: You are right, a little slower. next timeEarly.
Ning Zhichu raised his eyebrows in surprise - this big Buddhist guy could actually reflect on himself? What a rarity.
Tao Yaoyao, who was in her bun, laughed so hard that her hairpin trembled: Senior Gui actually reflected on it! Rarely seen in a thousand years! I have to write it down!
The chaos surging deep in the space cracks is still continuing. There was still a long way to go, but Ning Zhichu knew very well - this time she walked much easier than last time. Same road, different cultivation, different state of mind, and even the threat of those turbulent currents was more than one level weaker than last time in her perception.
As we walked forward, the turbulence never stopped. Wave after wave came over one after another, as if all the space power in this chaotic void were competing with the intruders, without giving any chance to breathe. There are horizontally sweeping violent turbulences that press over like a moving wall, there are vertically torn fine space blades that chop straight down from the top of the head like invisible long knives, there are space explosions that explode out of thin air and create circles of concussive ripples in the void, turning the surrounding chaotic airflow upside down. There are also hidden undercurrents hidden in the void that look calm on the surface but actually hide a deadly murderous intention underneath. All dangers appear randomly and without any rules. There are no warnings and no trajectory to predict. They all rely on reaction and perception.
If it were an ordinary tribulation cultivator walking in, even with the blessing of a protective barrier, he would have to be cautious every step of the way. If he were not careful, he would be hit by a turbulent flow, which could cause the protective barrier to shatter or suffer serious injuries. Many tribulation masters have never dared to set foot in a place like this all their lives, because the dangers here are too random and uncontrollable, and no one is sure that they will be able to get out alive.
But now Ning Zhichu's state is completely different. She walked steadily and calmly throughout the whole process, every step was in the right place, and every sideways turn accurately avoided the oncoming turbulence. The dangers that would embarrass ordinary tribulation cultivators seemed to be half a beat slower in front of her, and her movements were always faster than the turbulent flow.
Even if you occasionally encounter a sudden danger that is so fast that you have no time to react, the little turtle on your shoulder will warn you in advance. Its speaking speed is still slow, but its timing is much more precise than last time - at least it speaks when Ning Zhichu needs to take action, instead of waiting for her to finish hiding before adding another sentence. Every time Ning Zhichu heard the instructions, he immediately followed them without hesitation. He moved left, right, up, jumped and squatted. The whole set of movements was in perfect harmony.
Tao Yaoyao, who was watching the whole process from her bun, was convinced, and her thoughts in her hairpin never stopped.
Zhichu, you are too stable! There are so many messy dangers and you haven’t missed a step! I just saw that the turbulent flow on the left missed your back by just a tiny margin, and you didn't even blink your eyelids!
Ning Zhichu turned sideways to avoid an undercurrent emerging from the soles of his feet, and casually replied: I'm used to it. The more you walk, the more your body will remember the rhythm. Although the turbulence in space is random, people's reactions can be practiced.
